article.title: Sara Nelson calls in: FAA meltdown is a 50-year-old labor story
article.author: Editor
article.content: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy blamed an ongoing project being done by a contractor working on a telecommunications integration upgrade at a radar site in Amarillo, Texas which, as the Trump administration described it, destabilized 17 of the nation’s 22 air traffic control centers. The post Sara Nelson calls in: FAA meltdown is a 50-year-old labor story appeared first on MR Online .
